name: docket
description: A status and remote and personal flags for each conversation, with a board of all of them

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the band and the board.

ticketLinks.title: Ticket links
ticketLinks.description: JSON list of rules that turn a ticket named in a title into a link: [{"pattern": "\\b(ABC-\\d+)\\b", "url": "https://tracker.example.com/browse/{id}", "label": "{id}", "project": "my-repo"}]. {id} is the pattern's first group. url must start with https://. label, project and uppercase (true to write {id} in capitals) are optional.

projectColors.title: Project colors
projectColors.description: JSON map from a project (folder name, or "perso" for personal conversations) to a hue from 0 to 359, for example {"my-repo": 212}. Other projects get a hue from their name.

statuses.title: Statuses
statuses.description: JSON list of the statuses, in order: [{"id": "todo", "label": "To do"}, {"id": "doing", "label": "Doing"}]. The first one is given on a conversation's first message. An id is letters, digits and dashes. Empty: in progress, waiting, done, recycled.

flags.title: Flags
flags.description: JSON list of yes-or-no flags, each a band button and a board filter: [{"id": "client", "label": "Client", "on": "Client", "off": "Internal"}]. on and off are optional. Empty: remote and personal. [] for no flag.

statusControl.title: Status control
statusControl.description: How the band shows the status: buttons (one per status), dropdown (a picker), cycle (one button that moves to the next status on each press), or auto (buttons up to 5 statuses, a dropdown past that).

filters.title: Board filters
filters.description: JSON list of the board's filters, in order, filled row by row in two columns: "status", "period" and flag ids, for example ["status", "perso", "period", "remote"]. A filter left out is hidden and filters nothing. Empty: status, period, then every flag.

syncFolder.title: Sync folder
syncFolder.description: A folder your computers share, such as one in iCloud Drive or Dropbox: ~/Library/Mobile Documents/com~apple~CloudDocs/docket. Each computer writes its conversations there and the board shows the others'. Empty: nothing is shared.

machineName.title: Computer name
machineName.description: How the other computers name this one on their board. Empty: the computer's own name.
